name: Switzerland
dataProvenance: Swiss Civil Code (ZGB) Art. 457–640, January 2023 succession law reform (Erbrechtsrevision)
description: Swiss succession rules: Pflichtteil (forced heirship after 2023 Erbrechtsrevision), cantonal inheritance tax variation, matrimonial property regimes, Erbschein (certificate of inheritance), and notarial will forms.

conformanceRules.description: Matrimonial property regime should be specified for Swiss estates where a surviving spouse exists

keyFeatures: 2023 revised forced heirship rules, cantonal succession tax variation, usufruct rights
